title: Steering the Teacher: Improving On-Policy Self-Distillation for Thinking Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34005v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own reasoning trajectories using token-level supervision from a reference-conditioned teacher initialized from the same model. However, access to the reference can induce teacher behaviors that undermine independent reasoning in thinking models, leading to reference hallucinations, where the student cites an unavailable reference to justify reasoning steps, and reconsideration suppression, where the teacher discourages verification and revision at uncertain steps. We introduce Steered-Teacher OPSD (ST-OPSD) to jointly address these failure modes through activation steering. ST-OPSD extracts two directions from model-generated reasoning trajectories and applies them to the teacher's hidden states during distillation target computation, suppressing reference-invoking behavior and encouraging reconsideration with marker-family calibration. translated_title: 引导教师：改进思考模型的同策略自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过在学生模型自身的推理轨迹上进行训练，并使用从同一模型初始化的、以参考为条件的教师模型提供的token级别监督来训练学生模型。然而，对参考的访问可能诱发教师模型的某些行为，从而破坏思考模型的独立推理能力，导致两类问题：参考幻觉，即学生模型引用不存在的参考来论证其推理步骤；以及重新考虑抑制，即教师模型不鼓励学生在不确定的步骤进行验证和修订。我们提出了引导教师OPSD（ST-OPSD），通过激活引导技术联合解决这些失败模式。ST-OPSD从模型生成的推理轨迹中提取两个方向，并在计算蒸馏目标时将其应用于教师模型的隐藏状态，从而抑制调用参考的行为，并通过标记族校准来鼓励重新考虑。学生模型从由此产生的教师模型中学习……
tldr: 本文提出ST-OPSD方法，通过从推理轨迹中提取激活方向来引导教师模型的隐藏状态，从而解决自蒸馏中的参考幻觉和重新考虑抑制问题，提升思考模型的独立推理能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ST-OPSD, which steers the teacher's hidden states using activation directions extracted from reasoning trajectories, jointly addressing reference hallucination and reconsideration suppression in on-policy self-distillation to improve independent reasoning in thinking models.
